rules: At most 2 appointments per Monday-to-Sunday week (America/New_York), across services; an appointment counts toward the week of its start unless it is cancelled.
A booking needs an open slot that starts after now. The writing centre requires a draft reference. Take-home exam work is not tutored.

Only the centre records attendance (completed or no_show), once, however late. Until then a started appointment is awaiting_outcome: it still counts toward its week and is not a no-show.
When a no-show or late cancellation is recorded and 2 or more are dated within the last 30 days, the student is suspended for 14 days from that moment. A suspension refuses new bookings only.
